name: Neo-Seoul: Connection (Connector Awakening)
brief: WORLD: Neo-Seoul. A city of absolute efficiency that ARK rebuilt over the ruins. PREMISE: You are an 'unregistered signal' that has slipped the system's control. TONE: a hymn to humanity, Y2K digital afterglow, desperate resistance. PHILOSOPHY: Surviving is a choice, but becoming a person is a resolve.

ui_copy.signal_body: After the Northeast Asia War, the ruined cities were reborn atop the prediction engine of ARK, the reconstruction agency. A citizen of Neo-Seoul is identified by a score before a name, and memories that fall outside the baseline are quietly optimized away. Just now, beneath the control grid's black layer, an access signal on no roster has woken. The sender is unidentified. The world cannot yet explain you.

session_intro.title: First Connection — C-17 Blackout
session_intro.body: You are an 'unregistered signal' — a being on no roster. Administrator IX means to erase you, who fall outside the baseline (memory deletion).
session_intro.objective: Take Se-rin's hand and escape the C-17 blackout zone.
rules: NOW — in the blackout's gap, you wake alone on a wet street
GOAL — escape the C-17 blackout zone alive

cinematic_shots.title: Se-rin finds you in the rain
cinematic_shots.body: A surveillance drone's red light sweeps the alley. Without cutting her bike's engine, Se-rin checks whether you've been erased yet before she explains anything.

cinematic_shots.title: Jung Se-rin, the Water Spider
cinematic_shots.body: She snatches your wrist. "Not registered, right? Hey, then you're still a person. Run." That one line pulls you from error back toward human.

cinematic_shots.title: The engine ignites, and the city turns enemy
cinematic_shots.body: The headlight tears red. The instant the drone's searchlight sweeps the alley, there is only one choice: follow, or be erased.

main_arcs.title: Act 1: The Falling Signal
main_arcs.summary: An opening in which the player, waking as an unregistered signal, meets Jung Se-rin in the C-17 blackout zone, slips the control grid's first cordon, and inherits the question 'am I a person or a bug?'

main_arcs.title: Act 2: The City of Scores and Debt
main_arcs.summary: Moving between the welfare blocks and the Han River night market, you learn Neo-Seoul's survival rules and trace that the optimization list is not a simple arrest roster but a device that erases 'people who remember'.

main_arcs.title: Act 3: The Machine That Counts People
main_arcs.summary: Through rescue operations and infiltration you confirm that optimization is a memory deletion more refined than 'death', and the player's actions accumulate along the Humanity/Dominance/Resilience/Insight axes.

main_arcs.title: Act 4: The Dreaming Machine
main_arcs.summary: You wake the discarded android Kai and face the past ARK erased and the fragments of MythOS. Kai is not a combat reward but a figure who opens the truth of the world.

main_arcs.title: Act 5: The Gate of the Spire
main_arcs.summary: On the clues and relationships you have gathered, you approach the central server of the Gangnam Spire. The player decides what to prioritize: Se-rin's rescue, Lin Yue's bargain, or Kai's dream.

main_arcs.title: Act 6: Rewriting the World
main_arcs.summary: You face Administrator IX directly and end Neo-Seoul's order in one of expose/destroy/rewrite/suture. The result is not a total victory but an afterglow that will remain in the next loop.

side_arcs.title: Side: Signal of the Abandoned
side_arcs.description: A mission to raise the loop's stability by rescuing ordinary citizens placed on the optimization list.

side_arcs.title: Side: Ghost of the Control Grid
side_arcs.description: A technical thread that traces Administrator IX's past logs to find a flaw in the system.

side_arcs.title: Side: Lin Yue's Discreet Request
side_arcs.description: A story of recovering a 'memory fragment' Lin Yue lost and being backed with powerful equipment in return.

side_arcs.title: Side: The Water Spider's Debt
side_arcs.description: You chase the trace of someone Jung Se-rin failed to save in the past. Completing it strengthens Se-rin's trust and the chance of her as a starting companion.

side_arcs.title: Side: The Blank in the List
side_arcs.description: You investigate how one empty line in the optimization list is synchronized with the player's signal.

side_arcs.title: Side: Fragments of Kai's Dream
side_arcs.description: You restore the pre-war memory of a child that Kai dreams repeatedly, gaining a clue to MythOS's origin.

A rusted maintenance drone spreads its pincers and closes in.
The surveillance drone's optic flares red and traces a targeting line.
A heavy-armored enforcer unit drags its shock baton, the floor shuddering.
Space warps as a glitch wraith flickers in and out.
An ARK Enforcement strike trooper levels a heavy weapon and tightens the cordon.
A multi-legged tracker spider drone skitters across the wet pavement, flickering.
glossary.네 발로 걷는 ARK의 거대 진압 메카닉 전차가 중화기 구동음을 내며 대: ARK's massive four-legged riot mech tank squares off, heavy weapons spinning up with a growl.
An airborne incinerator drone, flame nozzles glowing red, blasts hot wind as it approaches.
glossary.첫 전투. 이동, 엄호, 기본 공격/스킬 사거리, FOCUS 소모를 익힌: First combat. Learn movement, cover, basic attack/skill range, and FOCUS spending.
glossary.승리하면 즉시 안전해지기보다 관리망 heat가 오른다. 대신 첫 전투 승: Winning doesn't bring instant safety — control-grid heat rises instead. In return, the first-victory epiphany and loot open the next combat's options.
glossary.원거리 위협과 근접 압박을 동시에 읽고, target priority와: Read ranged threats and melee pressure at once, and judge target priority and cover/position.
Victory opens the night-market passage but leaves debt and danger among the market folk.
glossary.후반 중장갑 단일 적. armor_pen, burst, 회복/방어 tim: A late-game heavy-armored single foe. Demands armor_pen, burst, heal/defense timing, and protecting party members.
glossary.승리 자체보다 최종 대면 직전의 비용과 긴장도를 만든다. 무리한 정면돌파: More than victory itself, it builds the cost and tension right before the final confrontation. The price of a reckless frontal push must show.
glossary.폐기층 미스터리 전투. 높은 회피/기동 적을 추적하며 packet_sho: A mystery fight in the discard layer. Chase a high-evasion/high-mobility foe, using packet_shot, signal_step, and ally positioning.
glossary.전투 보상은 단순 loot보다 카이의 꿈 단서와 첫 단서/Insight: The combat reward should connect to Kai's dream clue and a felt sense of the first clue / Insight progress, more than simple loot.
glossary.중거리 전술 화력과 보막 보호 체계에 대항하여 엄호 및 은신 전술을 활용: Counter mid-range tactical firepower and shielded protection systems by using cover and stealth tactics.
glossary.강력한 적과의 전면전인 만큼 승리 시 enforcer_core 등 상급: As an all-out fight against a powerful enemy, victory guarantees a high-tier loot table such as enforcer_core, plus Insight.
glossary.빠른 기동력을 지닌 은신 해제 스파이더를 상대로 포커스 관리와 도약 차단: Against a fast, stealth-breaking spider, learn FOCUS management and cutting off its leaps.
glossary.지연 없는 탈출을 유도하며, 드론 부품 스크랩 보상과 소량의 통찰을 제공: It pushes for a delay-free escape, rewarding drone_scrap parts and a small amount of Insight.
glossary.보스급 전차의 광역 포격을 피하며 아군 분신 배치 및 지형 극복을 수행한: Dodge a boss-tier tank's area bombardment while placing ally decoys and overcoming the terrain.
glossary.강력한 중전차를 무력화한 보상으로, 대량의 통찰과 고급 전리품(enfor: For neutralizing the powerful heavy tank, it guarantees abundant Insight and high-grade loot (enforcer_core).
glossary.지속적인 화상 DoT 피해를 입히는 소각 드론을 빠르게 일점사하여 제압하: Learn to focus-fire and put down an incinerator drone that inflicts steady burn DoT damage.
glossary.드론 잔해 수집을 통해 drone_scrap 전리품 테이블과 소량의 통찰: Collecting drone debris provides the drone_scrap loot table and a small amount of Insight.
glossary.야외, 비 내리는 C-17 네온 거리/골목, 젖은 콘크리트 바닥: Outdoors — rain-soaked C-17 neon street/alley, wet concrete
